slides.hook: my whole leg day, exercise by exercise

slides.name: Calf Press
slides.text: full stretch at the bottom, pause, then press.

slides.name: Seated Leg Curl
slides.text: pad just above your heels. curl all the way, control it back.

slides.name: Leg Extension
slides.text: squeeze at the top for a second. slow on the way down.

slides.name: Adductor Machine
slides.text: start at a stretch you can control. squeeze the pads together.

slides.name: Hip Thrust
slides.text: chin tucked, ribs down. pause at the top.

slides.label: real tip
slides.text: 5 exercises, 10 working sets. i log every one so next week has a target.
